LigandMPNN designs

LigandMPNN redesigns a sequence over a fixed backbone while accounting for bound ligands and context. A lower score is a higher likelihood under the model. Sequence recovery — the fraction of positions matching the native sequence — is only available when a reference sequence was supplied.
